Elena (CS): quick FYI — BrightHarbor onboarding: during their 3pm PST activation window we see p99 tail latency jumping to ~1.8s on some requests when they hit bursts (~900 req/s). p50/p95 fine. Concerned because they demo on Fri. Looking for pre-demo mitigations.

Cheng (Infra): thanks. do we have evidence it's long-context churn or cold kv-cache evictions? if it's cache churn we can enable session-affinity + prefetching. if it's just long prefixes we can route those to a compact-int4 profile.

Elena (CS): pasted a redacted sample: `trace://brightharbor/2026-03-22/slotA` — patterns: long session history + occasional bulk backfills after reconnects, and streaming + ephemeral function calls.

Andre (ML): model note: compact-v3-int4 (per-tensor asymmetric, extra calibration) ran well on similar enterprise prompts in our eval harness. quality delta negligible on our metric suite (BLEU-ish analog within 1.0%) and median latency down ~33% in lab. p99 improved but depends on routing granularity and prefetch.

Cheng (Infra): proposed mitigation pack (canary-first):
```
- rule: if session.history_tokens > 800 || event=backfill
  action: route-> compact-v3-int4
  canary_pct: 0.03
  canary_duration: 48h
- default: route-> main-v2
- enable: session-affinity: true
- enable: prefix-prefetch: keep_n=3
```
We'll also set pre-warm hot paths for sessions seen in the last 15m. autoscale headroom US-WEST shows ~18% at peak per ops-bot.

Priya (CS): I'll ping BrightHarbor eng to request a sanitized prompt sample and ask permission for a small canary. also will book a 20m sync Thurs AM to walk them through the plan.

Sam (Account): renewal lingo: renewal review in 5 weeks. If we can show a repeatable tail reduction for their demo, it helps the success narrative. Any risks customer-visible?

Andre (ML): main risk is subtle response distribution shifts on very long-chain-context queries or rare function-invocation ordering. mitigation: run targeted drift eval using their sanitized prompts during canary. automated rollback if metric regression >1.2% (or subjective failure increase). I'll run the eval by EOD and post matrix.

Cheng (Infra): infra actions: create canary config + staging run by tomorrow morning, attach Andre's eval matrix to canary gating, implement automated rollback on drift, and set alert if p99 > 1.5s for 10min. ticket created #INF-4498.

ops-bot: infra-note: staging cluster ok, canary quota available. created ticket INF-4498.

Elena (CS): action list: Andre: eval + matrix (EOD), Cheng: canary & prefetch config (tomorrow AM), Priya: customer prompts + opt-in + Thurs sync, Sam: renewal brief with perf delta. will draft a short customer-facing summary if numbers look good. tagging owners @Andre (ML) @Cheng (Infra) @Priya (CS). :sparkles:
